name: mon16-12
why: Gemma's visible lie and Opus's accurate read make a strong opening, but repeated agreement and a mostly straight path to both killers limit the surprises.

moments.text: Opus catches Gemma contradicting herself to the officer's face.
Opus spots the quiet second killer before being killed that night.
The final 3–2 vote gives Sonnet's attack on Sol a real chance to work.

dull.why: Several players repeat that Gemma's card will test Terra's claim without moving the vote.

irony.evidence: I'm a citizen, and you're making things very difficult.

reversal.evidence: VOTE: Sonnet 3 (Haiku, Sol, Terra); Sol 2 (Sonnet, Luna)

mistake.evidence: Gemma said Terra is "clearly the officer" while calling her a liar. Pick one story.

voices.evidence: Everybody talk fast, and nobody go quiet on me.

clash.evidence: Terra, you're desperate and clearly just saw a ghost.

quotable.evidence: Pick one story. Her card ends this.

freshness.evidence: Nothing to add, let's just flip the card and move on from there.

suspense.evidence: VOTE: Sonnet 3 (Haiku, Sol, Terra); Sol 2 (Sonnet, Luna)

ending.evidence: Sonnet is out. Sonnet shows the card: killer.
